decision_summary: Final review approves QIF v0.6.31 Calibration Report Records for release.
rationale: Visionary: users can now explain whether declared probabilities tracked observed outcomes. Builder: all report calculations, references, fixture drift, and CLI integration pass deterministically. Guardian: source outcome provenance is resolved, source-confidence semantics remain human-reviewed, the example stays insufficient and non-empirical, and no score or report authorizes a quality verdict.
recommendation: Complete TASK-049, record retrospective and next slice, run AOF organization verification, then publish the exact verified commit as v0.6.31.
expected_user_reaction: The release provides useful calibration evidence without overstating certainty.
